title: A comparative analysis of MCDA methods for safe and sustainable by design assessment
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00028B, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Takshak Shende, Viktor Popov
Compensatory MCDA methods fail as SSbD safety gates by allowing sustainability to offset hazards. We recommend a two-stage hybrid approach: a strict non-compensatory safety gate, followed by sustainability ranking for safe alternatives.
